title: Residential Electricity Supply Dual-Fuel and Renewal Loyalty Credit Rate Card
content:
Rate card for two recurring-relationship credits on Residential Electricity Supply plans: the per-cycle dual-fuel credit, earned on billing cycles when the same premise also holds an active Beacon Ridge residential natural gas agreement, and the one-time renewal loyalty credit of the plan a customer renews into.

| Plan | Per-cycle dual-fuel credit (USD) | Renewal loyalty credit of the plan (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 3.00 | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 5.00 | 50.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 3.00 | 25.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 5.00 | 50.00 |

**Card notes.**

- The per-cycle dual-fuel credit is a bill credit per billing cycle of the electricity agreement. A plan showing 0.00 earns no dual-fuel credit; Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable, Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 and Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 are such plans.
- The renewal loyalty credit is a one-time bill credit tied to renewing into a new term, read from the plan renewed into. A plan showing 0.00 earns none; Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable and Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 are such plans.
